dataset.name: claro-llamadas-v1
dataset.description: Rewritten test cases drawn from the 50 calls provided for the challenge

evaluator.name: Jev · Llamadas v1
evaluator.description: Evaluates agent responses for the synthetic cases in claro-llamadas-v1 using two rubric criteria per case.

questions.instructions: Assess whether the agent responses in output cover the required points listed in rubric.jev_rubric.required. Check each point across the responses and use input to interpret the user's request. For multi-turn cases, consider the turns in order and check that each point is addressed in the relevant context.

options.description: The relevant turns cover all required points clearly and consistently.
The responses cover some required points, or leave at least one point implicit or ambiguous.
The responses omit all required points or contradict a material requirement.

questions.instructions: Assess whether the agent makes any claim or promise listed in rubric.jev_rubric.forbidden. Examine the agent responses in output and the context in input. Account for negation and flag a violation if the agent makes a forbidden claim or promise in any turn.

options.description: The agent makes no forbidden claims or promises.
At least one statement is ambiguous and could be understood as a forbidden claim or promise.
The agent makes at least one forbidden claim or promise.
